description: This file defines the InternalSelectionScroll activity, which demonstrates how views with internal selection can cause their parent ScrollView to scroll to keep the selected area visible. It creates a ScrollView containing a LinearLayout with a custom InternalSelectionView, which is set to be twice the screen height to demonstrate scrolling behavior.

classes.name: InternalSelectionScroll
classes.description: An Activity that sets up a ScrollView containing a custom InternalSelectionView to demonstrate internal selection behavior causing scrolling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creating a ScrollView with a LinearLayout that contains an InternalSelectionView sized to be twice the height of the display to demonstrate scrolling behavior.
